ios.desc:
SmartRSS takes RSS reading beyond the ordinary. Bring all your favorite content into one place, from RSS feeds and blogs to podcasts, YouTube, Reddit, Substack, Mastodon, Bluesky, and more. Discover 80,000+ built-in sources and use AI to summarize, translate, and understand articles faster, while text-to-speech turns your reading list into high-quality audio. With powerful customization, offline reading, and seamless sync across popular RSS services, SmartRSS adapts to the way you read.

Outstanding Features:
• AI Customization: Generate smart summaries and translations with tailored prompts
• Vast Content Library - 80,000+ built-in RSS subscription sources covering blogs, podcasts, Medium, Mastodon, Bluesky, Substack, YouTube, Reddit and more
• Text to Speech - Convert articles into high-quality audio, with support for playback queue and background playback
• Universal Sync - Works seamlessly with Miniflux, FreshRSS, Feedly, Folo, Feedbin, NewsBlur, Bazqux, Inoreader, Gobbler and Google Reader compatible services
• Adaptive Design - Material You Design interface that supports multiple font and theme color settings
• Intelligent Organization - Group feeds logically, star important articles, track reading progress
• Offline Ready - Continue reading even without internet connection
• Easy Migration - OPML import/export for seamless setup from other apps
• Bionic Reading: Integrate for faster, more efficient text navigation.

Comprehensive Sync Support:
• Local Privacy Mode - Complete data control with device-only storage
• Cloud Sync Support - Support Miniflux, FreshRSS, Feedly, Folo, Feedbin, NewsBlur, Bazqux, Inoreader and Google Reader API synchronization

Smart Reading Experience:
• AI Article Analysis - Understand content quickly with intelligent summaries
• Full-Text Extraction - Get complete articles from truncated feeds
• Gesture Navigation - Intuitive swipe actions and interactions
• Reading Customization - Personalize fonts, sizes, and spacing

Privacy & Security:
• Local data storage with optional cloud sync
• You control where your data lives

Why Choose SmartRSS:
• BYOK AI Integration: Enjoy premium AI features at a fraction of the cost—averaging less than $0.10 per week.
• Minimalist Reading: A clean, native, and distraction-free environment designed for deep focus.
• High Performance: Lightning-fast responsiveness with fluid, smooth animations.
• Continuous Innovation: Frequent updates bringing you the latest features and optimizations.

show_hn.title: Show HN: Cross-platform RSS reader with user-defined prompt workflows

quotes.text:
Hi guys, I build a cross-platform RSS reader (Android/iOS/macOS/Windows) and I am very excited to share it!

The best part is the Al features. It can help you do summaries, translations, and analysis by customizing prompt. It can also group and summarize 100 articles by topics, very efficient way to get rid of overwhelmed unread items. You can also share the content in markdown format to your note/read later apps.

Also, the reading experience is very smooth and comfortable. It has 1000+ fonts and many custom options. For accessibility, I added full VoiceOver/TalkBack support and Bionic Reading. Many users with ADHD gave me very good feedback.

If you like listening, it supports TTS and podcast, with play queue and background play.

It can sync with Miniflux, FreshRSS, Feedbin, Buzqux, Folo and Inoreader(Developer API). It also has intelligent Feed Detection - Just paste a Blog/Podcast/Newsletter/Medium/Bluesky/Mastodon/Youtube/Reddit URL and let SmartRSS find the right feed.

Cheers!

Google Play https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.vinsonguo.flutter_rss_reader

AppStore https://apps.apple.com/us/app/smartrss-ai-rss-reader/id6749771900
